title: Mechanical grinding mediated lanthanum modified silicon carbide based nitride carbon composite material enhances adsorption of dye wastewater
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,26190-26204
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09430E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Fanxia Zhang, Yuan Min, Yuzhu Ji, Jia Yang, Zhiliang Jin, Zhiqiang Wu
Lax-g-C3N4@β-SiC was synthesized via thermal condensation and mechanical methods. It adsorbed ARS (93.23%, 62.17 mg·g−1) and AF (70.33%, 46.9 mg·g−1) via monolayer chemical adsorption, with excellent stability over 8 cycles.
